kindness: Small acts of kindness can make a big difference.
sharing: Sharing and taking turns makes play more fun for everyone.
honesty: Telling the truth helps us fix mistakes together.
patience: Taking a breath and trying again helps us learn.
teamwork: Listening and working together helps us solve problems.
asking_for_help: Asking for help is a brave way to learn.
listening: Listening carefully helps us understand what others need.
inclusion: Inviting someone to join can help them feel welcome.
gratitude: Saying thank you shows others we notice their kindness.
practice: A little practice helps us get better at new things.
rest: Taking a break can help us feel ready to try again.
creativity: Trying a different idea can help solve a tricky problem.
responsibility: Putting things away helps everyone find what they need.
apologizing: Saying sorry and making things right helps friendships grow.
respect: Asking before borrowing shows care for other people's things.
nature: Small acts of care help plants and animals thrive.
fairness: Taking turns gives everyone a chance to enjoy the fun.
empathy: Thinking about another person's feelings helps us be kind.
self_kindness: It is okay to make mistakes while learning something new.
promises: Keeping a small promise helps others know they can trust us.
